Frequency once per round

Trigger Your marked target leaves your reach.

One opponent, one line of ground. Nothing else in the room is your problem.

You Step to remain adjacent to it, if a single Step will do. This costs no action and does not use your reaction. If one Step will not reach, you instead gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that target this round. You cannot use this while wielding a shield or a second weapon.
